# E0368: a lens leaves a required field unwritten for some instance

The target schema requires a field the lens never writes, so no result is an
instance of the target. Write the field: from the input, as a constant, or
through a mapping.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0368]: b in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is required by the target schema and never written
  --> lineage.cue:22:3
   |
22 |         result: {
   |         ^^^^^^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule required-not-written)
```
